intro: Seating that understands movement. GRETA 2.0’s ActiLumbar technology adjusts to your posture, offering seamless comfort whether you’re leaning in, sitting back, or powering through your day.

features.title: A chair that understands your body
features.text: No need to adjust—our chair does it for you. The intelligent tilt tension adapts to your weight, keeping you effortlessly supported in every position.

features.title: Comfort that adjusts to you
features.text: Comfort is personal, and GRETA 2.0 gets that. With adjustable headrest, armrests, lumbar support, and more, you can fine-tune every feature to match your preferences—so you stay focused, comfortable, and productive all day long.

features.title: Support you can rely on
features.text: The broad backrest isn’t just for looks—it cradles your back whether you’re upright or reclined, offering dependable support that makes long hours at your desk easier.

features.title: Feel good, sit better
features.text: Stay relaxed through busy workdays with a chair designed to support your whole body. GRETA 2.0 keeps you comfortable, so you can focus on what matters.

features.title: Better for you and the planet
features.text: Feel good about your choice—GRETA 2.0 is Indoor Advantage Gold certified, meeting strict standards for indoor air quality and sustainability. It’s better for you and kinder to the planet.

name: Greta 2 0 Fabric Ergonomic Office Chair
